name: nf-fbt
description: Establish selected Norfolk Island employer fringe benefits tax rules for the FBT year ending March 2027. Use for employee benefits, private expense reimbursements, work items, minor benefits, GST-creditable gross-up, reportable benefits, annual returns, instalments and records. Separates employer tax from employee reporting and island GST treatment. Includes primary sources, fictional computations and strict threshold checks. Preserves electric-car application and hybrid savings conditions, the April 2027 work-item transition, valuation and evidence gates, universal and payroll outputs, and professional review. Actual elections, specialised benefits, forms and complete country requirements remain open.
